New paragraph "{{(i) ... the corporation is authorized to enter into agreements as may be necessary for the administration and reporting of funds...}}"; ESD power; stored -02/-04 cover the following shall-sentence only.

New subdivision "{{7. ... the department is hereby authorized to allow phase two of a Green CHIPS project to enter into a new and separate schedule of benefits...}}"; ESD power; stored -02 is the next sentence (admission), not this one.
Wholly new AML s16 subd 47 "{{Evaluate, in conjunction with the state office for the Aging, programs and services...}}"; s16 lead is "The department shall:" so a DAM duty; law has no stored record.

Amends AML s16(47) "[sixty-two] {{sixty}} years of age": lowering the age widens the class of the existing DAM evaluation duty (criterion 7), so duty with extends_existing true; quote must be re-cut to include "{{sixty}} years of age or older" (criterion 2), current quote stops before the new matter.

New matter "(4) {{the amount collected for the additional fee ... shall be forwarded to the city comptroller for deposit in the animal population control fund}}"; duty on New York City (DOHMH as collector), same shape as stored -07; passive subject is not the actor (criterion 3).

New matter "(6) {{Any person who fails to renew ... may be required to pay a late fee ... with the amount of such late fee set by local law}}": a power of New York City to impose a late fee by local law (actor is the City, not the person); capped at 20 percent of base fee.

Uncodified new act section "s 7. Any system or method established by the commissioner of motor vehicles ... shall not be structured in a manner that substantially disadvantages..."; a prohibition binding DMV = duty; no stored equivalent (stored 2019-A3675 records are other provisions).

New matter "{{(ii) within the area known as Oceanside of the town...}}" added to VTL 1662-e(2) "Such residential parking permit system may only be established": widens the Town of Hempstead parking-permit power to a new place, power with extends_existing true (criterion 7); actor must be fixed to Towns / Town of Hempstead (model gave "such residential parking permit system", criterion 3); law has no stored record.

GBL 1303 fiduciary duty ("The board ... shall discharge their duties ... 3. by using any contributions paid by {{participating individuals,}} employees{{,}} and employers ... exclusively for..."): new matter widens the class covered by the board duty, duty with extends_existing true (criterion 7); quote is valid as it contains the new matter.

Quote is the tail of the definition of "implementation date" ("or as soon thereafter as the commissioner reasonably determines by regulation is feasible"): a content item/condition of the stored -04 duty ("Commencing on the implementation date..."); the commissioner discretion record is stored as -05 (phase-in).

Quote is a definition ("{{(b)(i) As used in this subdivision, \"accrediting organization\" means...}}"), not a duty or power; the real recognition duty is stored as 2021-A259-02 ("shall not unreasonably withhold recognition").

"When determining whether an applicant is operating predominantly ... the commissioner will examine the nature of the business activity at the location" is the method/condition of the eligibility determination already stored as 2011-S50002-26 ("The commissioner shall solely determine the eligibility").
